gaps: CONTROL_SINGLE_GENERATION_MANIFEST_GAP
Queue, restart request, current task, status, checkpoint, heartbeat, ownership, manual action and qa_latest are not bound by one canonical generation manifest.
Create one transition manifest containing every exact blob SHA and reject mixed generations.
CONTROL_STATUS_FRESHNESS_GAP
Canonical status was last updated on 27 July while support-QA advanced through 30 July, with no machine-readable stale-status verdict.
Record observed_at, authoritative_head and maximum age; fail closed when canonical status is stale.
CONTROL_CHECKPOINT_SOURCE_HEAD_GAP
Checkpoint says GitHub remote is authoritative but omits the exact source_head used to derive continuation identity.
Store source_head and recompute continuation_key from the documented formula before every transition.
CONTROL_CURRENT_TASK_EXACT_WRITE_PATHS_GAP
Current task exposes no exact_write_paths even though execution requires explicit authorized paths.
Require a non-empty exact_write_paths array with exact file or directory semantics before claim.
CONTROL_ALLOWED_PATHS_SCOPE_EQUIVALENCE_GAP
Queue allowed_paths is broader and semantically different from exact_write_paths, with no equivalence proof.
Separate read, create, update and delete scopes and require exact normalized scope equality across records.
CONTROL_RESTART_REQUEST_EXPIRY_GAP
The restart request has a creation time but no expiry, nonce or maximum acknowledgement age.
Add a one-use nonce, expires_at and consumed receipt bound to task, attempt and continuation.
CONTROL_RESTART_ACK_LEASE_GAP
Restart request remains waiting without an acknowledgement owner, lease or retry sequence.
Require an optimistic acknowledgement transition with actor, lease, attempt count and remote commit.
CONTROL_MANUAL_ACTION_STALE_INDEX_GAP
Manual action evidence still points to Increment 177 while qa_latest has advanced to Increment 212.
Generate the evidence index from the current canonical generation and reject stale support pointers.
CONTROL_MANUAL_ACTION_ACTOR_IDENTITY_GAP
Manual action requests external F-host work but does not bind an authorized operator identity or execution host attestation.
Bind operator role, host identity, invocation nonce and signed or hashed execution receipt.
CONTROL_MANUAL_ACTION_EXPECTED_HASH_GAP
Required receipt paths are listed without expected generation, schema, terminal status or child hash requirements.
Define an exact receipt contract with expected hashes and accepted status values.
CONTROL_HEARTBEAT_OBSERVATION_GAP
Heartbeat is null and stale=true but the record omits observed_at, observed_head and the probe result that established absence.
Publish an observation receipt even for absent heartbeat, bound to remote head and probe time.
CONTROL_OWNERSHIP_OBSERVATION_GAP
Ownership has lease_version 0 and null owner but no observation generation or remote-head binding.
Bind unclaimed state to an observed commit and monotonic ownership generation.
CONTROL_PICKUP_AGE_ESCALATION_GAP
The queue has remained pickup_requested since 20 July without a bounded retry count, next retry time or parked terminal transition.
Apply retry budget and deterministic RECOVERY_PARKED transition after the configured threshold.
CONTROL_STATE_ENUM_DRIFT_GAP
Queue, restart, current-task and status use different free-form state strings without one enumerated transition table.
Define a versioned state machine and validate every predecessor/successor pair.
CONTROL_RESTART_SELF_IDENTITY_GAP
Restart request pins many child blobs but does not bind its own blob SHA inside the control generation.
Include the request blob SHA in the parent transition manifest and acknowledgement.
CONTROL_MANIFEST_TASK_SCOPE_GAP
Slot manifest grants broad write roots while the active task lacks an exact per-task mutation subset.
Intersect manifest roots with task exact_write_paths and publish the resolved mutation set.
CONTROL_SUPPORT_BUSINESS_INVARIANT_GAP
Support-QA operations grow independently, but no canonical invariant proves they cannot change business completion fields.
Require a signed/hashed invariant that support generations have business_rows_written=0 and no canonical progress mutation.
CONTROL_WEB_ROW_DUAL_CONTRACT_GAP
Canonical status contains a 3811-row current manifest expectation while runtime acceptance requires at least 1036 rows, without a precedence rule.
Name distinct metrics and pin the exact acceptance floor and current rendered count in one schema.
CONTROL_TEST_EVIDENCE_FRESHNESS_GAP
Status reports 332/332 tests while workflow run and artifact digest are carried elsewhere without one freshness link.
Bind test count, workflow run, artifact digest, commit and execution date in the canonical status generation.
CONTROL_SOURCE_REFRESH_EVENT_MANIFEST_GAP
Source freshness counters are aggregate numbers without a child manifest for each revalidation event.
Publish one event record per source with URL, time, result, licence and response hash.
CONTROL_CONTINUATION_RECOMPUTE_GAP
Records preserve continuation_key but omit source_head, so the documented hash formula cannot be independently recomputed.
Store all formula inputs and a recomputation receipt in queue, task and checkpoint.
CONTROL_TRANSITION_SEQUENCE_GAP
Checkpoint sequence 22 is not shared by status, current task, restart request, heartbeat, ownership and manual action.
Use one monotonic transition sequence across every state document.
CONTROL_MULTI_FILE_CONTENTS_ATOMICITY_GAP
GitHub Contents API mutations create separate commits, so a partial control transition can be visible between writes.
Create all blobs and one tree/commit, then advance the branch ref once from the expected parent.
CONTROL_QA_FORWARD_ONLY_CAS_GAP
qa_latest uses blob-SHA optimistic locking but no server-side rule rejects a lower increment or lower operation_end written from the current blob.
Validate monotonic increment and operation_end in a protected publisher before ref update.
